Question 10 asks about the preceding passage as a whole. Suppose the writer's primary purpose had been to explain how the Little Ice Age changed daily life across Europe. Would this essay accomplish that purpose?

options.A: Yes, because it describes how Londoners turned the frozen river into a fair with booths, coaches, and printing presses on the ice.
options.B: Yes, because it shows the cold putting watermen out of work, an example of the climate changing how ordinary people earned a living.
options.C: No, because it never mentions the Little Ice Age and blames the frozen river entirely on the narrow arches of the old London Bridge.
options.D: No, because it never leaves London, and even there it credits the end of the fairs mainly to a changed river, not a changed climate.
